senses.definition: (K§ 54, 3 γ) n. m. owner, lord (Syriac ܒܥܶܠ, used similarly; cf.BH בַּ֫עַל, √ בָּעַל; also 𝔗 בְּעֵיל);—cstr. בּ׳־טְעֵם Ezr 4:8, 9, 17 i.e. commander (AndrM 56* as translation of Persian framātār, commander).
